schema_extension_requests.rationale: Amass Goblins N is a keyword action combining conditional token creation with counter placement and a subtype-grant on an Army; no single controlled predicate captures the composite keyword action, and there is no shared rule id (rule:amass) or mechanic_template for Amass in shared_context. Modeled here via CREATES_OBJECT + ADDS_COUNTER as a workaround.
